about: Declarations both readers refuse alike: index.ParseDeclaration in Go, kern.declaration.parse in Python. Each refusal is a list of the substrings its message holds; taken are declarations both read alike, with the forbid list each reads; hash pins the declaration hash of a text, its CRLF read as LF.

refused.name: an output without a built-in value
a command without a class
refused.text:
name = "x"
contract = 1
help = "h"
[commands."x go"]
usage = "x go"
summary = "s"
group = "g"
help = "h"
